purpose: Classify the shared movement trajectory selected by the Type-0x3C, Type-0x3D, Type-0x3E, and Type-0x3F actor producers.

stream.name: ACTOR_MOVE_SHARED_TYPE3C_3D_3E_3F_RESPONSE
decoded: Thirty-four signed movement deltas form the shared response trajectory, beginning (+3,-1) and ending (+4,+1).
The direct Type-0x3D collision child and the Type-0x3C/0x3E/0x3F interaction spawners all select this same root; no separate per-type movement owner is claimed.

boundary_basis: Three independent interaction handlers write 0x0012146C into actor movement field +0x0A.
The Type-0x3D collision-response template at 0x001B8368 supplies the same pointer.
The exact lossless decode is 70 bytes and terminates at the self-loop before the unresolved remainder of the 0x001213F8-0x00121553 band.
